CustomField.description: When checked, every run of this action is logged however long it takes, even when Enable Trigger Performance Logging is off in Log Setting. If Suppress Performance Logging is also checked, Suppress wins and nothing is logged. Useful for monitoring specific actions during performance investigations.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Check to log every run of this action however long it takes, even when Enable Trigger Performance Logging is off in Log Setting. If Suppress Performance Logging is also checked, Suppress wins and nothing is logged.
CustomField.label: Force Performance Logging
